source.method: New imagegen 8-direction source selected for V32; chroma-key alpha cleanup; largest full-pose component extraction per source cell; grayscale neutral body; deterministic 256x256 POT packing; fire rows use clean aim/firing pose and skip colored muzzle row.

layout.pivot_policy: Runtime visual boot-contact correction: pivot is 15 px below visible body_bbox bottom so painted boot soles sit above the map ground line in M01 camera.
layout.bootfix_policy: Bootfix atlas adds small attached dark boot/sole caps at the cut lower-leg endpoints using bottom-silhouette anchors; no detached blocks or contact ellipses.

runtime_direction_contract.required_visual_read: screen upper-right toward the enemy group in M01 runtime crop

runtime_tint_contract.base_draw: neutral white/gray body_shadow_pot for all soldiers; no baked faction colors
runtime_tint_contract.mask_draw: optional technical mask atlas has identical frame rects, pivots, UVs, and sequence order if PM/user later requires faction mask tinting
runtime_tint_contract.do_not_tint: Do not tint the whole body atlas; do not bind colored preview art.
runtime_tint_contract.user_visual_direction: one neutral white/gray soldier atlas only; no blue/red/all-color presentation
